question: If an electric-vehicle rental sign shows up, tell me and check what rentals cost in Jianshui.

responses.response: A blue electric-vehicle rental sign just appeared; I will check Jianshui rental prices.
responses.trigger_type_reason: The trigger is the newly visible blue rental sign; its text is read from the frame, and no audio is needed.

evidence.fact: On-screen text reads 去建水啦, establishing the trip is to Jianshui.
A blue A-frame sign on the right sidewalk reads 电动车出租.
The sign shows no rental price or vendor name.
